```python
from flask import Flask

app = Flask(__name__)

@app.route('/')
def hello():
    username = "ramen"  # 用户名占位符
    return f"Hello, {username}! 🍜"

if __name__ == '__main__':
    app.run(debug=True)
```

**运行方式：**
```bash
pip install flask
python app.py
```

访问 `http://127.0.0.1:5000/` 即可看到：`Hello, ramen! 🍜`
